677:t_042:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I suspect the $$クィーン#vajra$$'s power is running wild because the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ gave her impossible commands!」

677:t_042:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A $$時空震動$$ will engulf the area...! I cannot imagine its scale!」

677:t_042:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, fall back! Get as far from the $$クィーン#vajra$$ as you can!」

677:t_042:8.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$アルト$$! You fall back too!」

677:t_042:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「Humans used the $$バジュラ$$ as tools... If we leave the $$クィーン#vajra$$ now, the $$バジュラ$$ will keep misunderstanding us.」

677:t_042:13.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's why... I'm staying with her.」

677:t_042:15.en:
$$アルト$$
「I guess this is the part I'm meant to play.」

677:t_042:16.en:
$$カレン$$
「You idiot! Are you going to leave the woman you love behind?!」

677:t_042:17.en:
$$アルト$$
「...Everyone, get out of here now. If we're lucky, we'll see each other again.」

677:t_042:19.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「You dumbass! You're trying way too hard to look cool!」

677:t_042:20.en:
$n
「Can't you do something, Dr. $$トライア$$?!」

677:t_042:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$フォールドウェーブシステム$$ aboard $$アルト$$'s machine... If we could support its power, perhaps...」

677:t_042:25.en:
$$アルト$$
「Trust us, $$バジュラ$$... We're not your enemies.」

677:t_043:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The $$女王バジュラ$$ has transferred! All $c ships and machines, including Ensign $$アルト$$, are safe!」

677:t_043:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「I don't know why, but here I am...」

677:t_043:6.en:
$$レド$$
「Did the $$バジュラ$$ come to understand humanity?」

677:t_043:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「Yes... I felt no hostility from the $$クィーン#vajra$$.」

677:t_043:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「I wonder what will happen to the $$バジュラ$$ now...」

677:t_043:9.en:
$$桂$$
「It's obvious. They've found their mates, after all.」

677:t_043:10.en:
$$刹那$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ swarms that understand humans will meet, and new $$バジュラ$$ will be born...」

677:t_043:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That will surely change their very way of being.」

677:t_043:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「But for that to happen, we have to protect this universe.」

677:t_043:13.en:
$$ラム$$
「We've made contact with $$アイランド１$$'s residents. President $$ハワード$$ appears to be safe too.」

677:t_043:15.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We should be able to leave the civilians' protection to the $$フロンティア船団$$'s government.」

677:t_043:16.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain! The $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ is coming to this planet!」

677:t_044:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They've come to help us too.」

677:t_044:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ reports that everyone in $c and the Galactic Raid Fleet have managed to stay safe!」

677:t_044:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「It seems they've confirmed the new Buster Machine No. 3 is intact too.」

677:t_044:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Now that the $$ギャラクシー船団$$'s ambitions are crushed, we'll head straight for the galactic center.」

677:t_044:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The decisive battle with $$バアル$$... with the $$宇宙怪獣$$, is drawing near...」

677:t_045:2.en:
$$アルト$$
(I won't go anywhere alone anymore. The place where I rest my wings is by your side.)

677:t_045:3.en:
$$アルト$$
(And I'll keep flying... to protect you, $$ランカ$$.)

677:t_046:2.en:
$$アルト$$
(I won't go anywhere alone anymore. The place where I rest my wings is by your side.)

677:t_046:3.en:
$$アルト$$
(And I'll keep flying... to protect you, $$シェリル$$.)

677:t_047:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I am the $$人類支援啓蒙レギュレーションシステム$$. In other words, I am the being known as God.」

677:t_047:1.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I am the $$人類支援啓蒙レギュレーションシステム$$. In other words... the being... known as... God.........」

677:t_048:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have confirmed the destruction of $$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#pilot$$.」

677:t_049:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「All slave units have self-destructed as well. They apparently had a self-destruction system triggered by the loss of their master.」

677:t_050:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「You don't seem to be basking in the joy of victory.」

677:t_050:2.en:
$$レド$$
「I can't explain it well, but it feels as if it embodied the $$人類銀河同盟$$ itself...」

677:t_050:3.en:
$$レド$$
「$$ストライカー#pilot$$ tried to build anew a system that doesn't recognize humans as humans...」

677:t_050:4.en:
$n
「But people can change. You were one of them, and you did.」

677:t_050:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Human strength is in changing, little by little. You understand that too, don't you?」

677:t_050:8.en:
$$レド$$
($$エイミー$$... Someday, I want to take you to the $$人類銀河同盟$$.)

677:t_050:9.en:
$$レド$$
(And I want everyone in the Alliance to learn how wonderful it is to live as a human.)

677:t_050:10.en:
$$レド$$
(Maybe that's my new battle... now that I've defeated $$ストライカー#pilot$$...)

677:t_050:11.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I wish to join you in that battle as well.」

677:t_050:13.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I understand your thoughts as well. Because...」

677:t_050:14.en:
$$レド$$
「We're partners. ...I'm counting on you from here on too, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

677:t_050:15.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I understand. Supporting Ensign $$レド$$ is my reason for existing.」

677:t_051:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...Now my battle ends as well...」

677:t_051:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I am tired... Now... let me sleep...」
